policy: Custom flat icon family drawn for Certificate Flow Lab. Not official Microsoft icons. No external icon assets are used.

icons.label: Client computer
icons.description: A desktop computer with a monitor

icons.label: Browser window
icons.description: A web browser window with a padlock

icons.label: IIS web binding
icons.description: A web site with a globe, representing an IIS HTTPS binding

icons.label: Certificate request
icons.description: A document with a key hole, representing a CSR

icons.label: Policy gate
icons.description: A shield with a checklist, representing template policy

icons.label: Issuing CA
icons.description: A server with a certificate seal, representing the online Issuing CA

icons.label: Offline Root CA
icons.description: A server with a padlock, representing the offline Root CA trust anchor

icons.label: Publication server
icons.description: A web server publishing PKI files

icons.label: AIA repository
icons.description: A certificate with a download arrow, representing issuer certificate download (AIA)

icons.label: CDP / CRL repository
icons.description: A list with a blocked entry, representing a certificate revocation list (CDP)

icons.label: Trust decision
icons.description: A shield, representing the trust decision

icons.label: Domain Controller
icons.description: A server with a directory tree badge, representing a Domain Controller

icons.label: Certificate store
icons.description: A drawer holding certificates, representing a certificate store
